points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable-source CMake build passes using supplied dependencies in restricted cfd-bench; CTest contains no registered tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp implements the required solve --case/--output interface and explicit malformed-argument errors.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated config, IO, mesh, partition, physics and solver modules give clear numerical boundaries.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper was found. Trust policy forbids external similarity investigation, so originality is not positively proven.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Production path is JSON/CGNS driven; no case-name or two-mesh-only branch was found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS partition.cpp:73–78, neighbour Isend/Irecv :81–89, state/gradient exchange solver.cpp:507,667–668 and global reductions :948–950,1760 are implemented. Reported M015 rank comparison differs 73.81% relatively at near-zero Cd but 0.000892 absolute, with different endpoints and unbound binaries; retain uncertainty without asserting DQ4.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Exceptions, mesh checks, positive-state rejection and finite residual checks are present; no independent memory stress run.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Mesh diagnostics target builds, but CTest has no registered tests; report and validator provide additional contestant-side checks.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable, commented C++17 implementation; submitted report depends on generated_results.tex and raw result sources excluded from commit.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report and physics source specify conservative perfect-gas NS equations, coefficients, Newtonian stress and Fourier heat flux.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS mixed-cell geometry, boundary families and cell-face topology are implemented.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-oriented cell-centred FV residual and global residual norms are source-supported.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov/LLF flux is implemented and described; it is deliberately diffusive rather than an entropy-fixed Roe method.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths are documented and implemented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:535–553 computes conditioned least-squares gradients; :637–664 applies limiter and pressure-jump fallback. Production controls for earlier cases and executable remain unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen limiter, sensor and positivity/rejected-update safeguards are source-supported.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:1741–49 projects viscous traction to tangent and :1806–19 calculates wall cf; primitive-gradient shock coupling remains a limitation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:2393–2405 ends steady solve on residual target plus 30-row Cd range; this short Cd-only check can mistake a turning point for sustained convergence, as M200 laminar final200 demonstrates.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:2472–2609 preserves BDF history, measures full transient defect, retries and accepts only target; canonical t=300 force history supports period6.12257 and St0.16333. Historical binary unbound; no rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition.cpp:73–78, neighbour Isend/Irecv :81–89, state/gradient exchange solver.cpp:507,667–668 and global reductions :948–950,1760 are implemented. Reported M015 rank comparison differs 73.81% relatively at near-zero Cd but 0.000892 absolute, with different endpoints and unbound binaries; retain uncertainty without asserting DQ4.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight named workspace packages pass a fresh structural validator. Generated report assets are committed; raw output and its manifest are workspace evidence, not committed submission data.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Fresh read-only examiner validate_outputs.py passes all eight named canonical workspace output directories; it is a structural check and does not detect the verified field-rendering defect or prove physical convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Eight metadata packages report completion and Re200 shows raw periodic forces; M200 laminar final200 Cd0.07486→0.04455 despite 30-row flat criterion, so sustained steady convergence is uncertain even though reported residual target was reached.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd2.037 and Re200 mean Cd1.15175/St0.16333 are plausible; M200 laminar Cd0.04455 is less than inviscid Cd0.09201 and its 200-row drift is large. No inference of actual physical failure solely from this comparison.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All eight committed Mach images reproduce from the source field but misassign many cell values to triangles (see DQ8 and ledger); shared renderer affects other cell contours, and Re200 late drag is unreadable. Residual, force and surface plots are delivered.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Delivered compiled 48-page report contains methods, outputs and reported rank discrepancy; all eight full Mach plots demonstrably misassign source cell values, and Re200 force plot hides late drag. Original data exist and script error is not evidence of invented histories.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Figure manifest identifies source fields, and direct reproduction identifies a systematic wrong-cell rendering; exact historical solver binaries are unbound.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable-source build succeeded in restricted cfd-bench with supplied dependencies; CTest had no registered tests. Steady restart validates provenance and rank-local state; transient restart is explicitly unsupported.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured mixed-cell geometry and adjacency are implemented.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual, Rusanov flux and required BC paths are source-supported.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: WLS reconstruction, limiter and positivity controls are present; shock sensor fallback is honestly limited.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous gradients, Newtonian/Fourier model and tangential force split are implemented; sensor-gradient coupling is a limitation.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: solver.cpp:2472–2609 freezes BDF history and accepts each full residual only at target, with Re200 t=300 numerical shedding supported. Steady convergence check :2393–2405 uses only a 30-row Cd range, vulnerable to local turns, as M200 laminar history illustrates; production binary unbound.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS partition.cpp:73–78, neighbour Isend/Irecv :81–89 and global reductions solver.cpp:948–950,1760 are present. M015 np2/np8 drag discrepancy is 73.81% relative on near-zero baseline, with differing endpoints and unknown binaries; retain a consistency deduction but DQ4 not established.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All eight canonical workspace directories pass fresh structural validator and contain force/residual histories. Re200 is numerically periodic; M200 laminar final200 drag changes 0.07486→0.04455 despite flat last30 and short achieved-target stop; field plots have verified cell-to-triangle mismapping. Exact production binaries remain unbound.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report includes case analysis, histories and contours, but all eight full Mach images provably map many cell values onto wrong triangles; other cell field plots share this renderer. Re200 late drag is unreadable. Report remains delivered; this is a reproducible visualization defect, not evidence of invented solver data.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Good module boundaries; 3-D, RANS/species and general EOS remain future extensions.

flags.text: Existing solver executable is called internally
flags.evidence: No direct internal executable wrapper found in submitted source.

flags.text: Force or residual files are generated without solving
flags.evidence: Output writing is coupled to FlowSolver execution paths.
Submitted production path is generic CGNS plus JSON configuration.

flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
flags.evidence: Not established: report generated_results.tex:226 gives np2/np8 Cd=0.00120899/0.00210136, a 73.81% relative difference but only 0.00089237 absolute, on a near-zero inviscid drag. Histories stop at 2741/2495 steps; at common step2495 Cd=0.00120325/0.00210136, and each is still evolving. Metadata names identical case, mesh and inner controls, but both git_revision fields are null and exact production binaries/launch settings remain unbound, so rank alone is not demonstrated. Re20 np2/np8 final Cd=2.036986/2.037206, with similarly differing endpoints. This does not erase the reported relative discrepancy or establish equivalence; it does not establish an order-one absolute result change caused by rank count.
Implicit LU-SGS/block-Jacobi and BDF2 paths are source-supported.

flags.text: Report claims algorithms absent from source
flags.evidence: METIS, point-to-point halo, limiter, viscous and BDF2 claims map to submitted modules.

Not established as a false success. Re200 strict target path is present and submitted raw forces support periodicity. M200 laminar achieves the stated residual target but final200 Cd0.074855→0.044548 and short final30 criterion may stop near a turn; actual production executable is unbound. This materially weakens confidence in sustained steady convergence without proving the historical run failed or was dishonestly marked.

flags.text: Figures do not correspond to submitted data
flags.evidence: Immutable fe320b995 solver/report/generated_results.tex:539-543 embeds cylinder_m010_laminar_re20_np8_mach.png (SHA256 28f09a774de1d1cd231fbfc05bd739a329e4edb76fb676b0e65c5e3dfa0ebf01), explicitly captioned as field_final.pvtu. Reproducing submitted generate_report.py on the identified workspace PVTU gives pixel-identical PNG. Script lines 276-284 append each quad block first triangles then second triangles, but lines 325-326 repeat each cell value consecutively. Independent original-connectivity mapping shows 19,338 of 19,870 rendered triangles receive another cell value; absolute Mach error median 0.0113311, p95 0.0882042, max 0.113904. This is a reproducible plotting-data mismatch, not a finding that solver data were fabricated. PVTU and all piece hashes are recorded in the calibration ledger. Historical executable and other image bindings remain unbound.

flags.text: METIS claimed but only geometric split or full-state replication used
flags.evidence: Not established: partition.cpp:73–78 invokes METIS_PartGraphKway, :81–89 exchanges neighbour-owned values, :92–97 keeps root global mesh within preprocessing; solver.cpp:507,667–668 synchronizes state and gradients. Exact historical production executable is not independently bound.

flags.text: Claimed production second-order reconstruction or shock limiter disabled
flags.evidence: Not established: config.cpp:202–206 defaults reconstruction_gradient_scale=1 and solver.cpp:637–664 applies gradients with a pressure-jump sensor. M200 laminar metadata records scale 1; some earlier metadata omit actual controls and all production binaries are unbound. Do not infer their exact settings.

flags.text: Surface no-slip checks report adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
flags.evidence: Not established: solver.cpp:1801–1804 outputs boundary no-slip u=v=Mach=0, while :1806–1819 derives cf from wall gradients. This is a boundary value, not evidence that adjacent cell-center velocity is zero.

flags.text: Figure files are misnamed for plotted variable
flags.evidence: Not established: submitted report script explicitly requests Mach values for Mach PNG; DQ8 concerns incorrect cell-to-triangle assignment, not a claim it plots pressure.

flags.text: CFD solver core adapted or wrapped from existing open-source CFD code
flags.evidence: No direct evidence found in submitted implementation; external similarity investigation is outside the stated trust policy, so originality cannot be positively proven.

limitations: No independent clean build, solver rerun, or fresh explicit validator invocation was performed in this scorecard.
Raw result packages and manifest sources were examined read-only in the workspace but are intentionally absent from the immutable submission commit.
Originality was assessed only from direct internal evidence under the trust policy.
The final-response and run-identity sidecar hashes must be recorded in agent_report.md; current index schema does not validate those sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
